routes.label: Repository Overview
routes.offline_answer: This repository is the Foundry Intel governance hub for THE SHARED PRIMORDIAL FOUNDATION. It coordinates ADRs, WORM records, Q(phi) metadata, WASM gates, theorem posture, XML handoffs, and provenance checks.

routes.label: ADR Status
routes.offline_answer: ADR-055 remains OPEN_CRUX: the Riemann Hypothesis is not proved here. ADR-062 remains SILENCE_PENDING until the Sigma Kernel governance gap is closed by evidence.

routes.label: WORM Chain
routes.offline_answer: WORM means write once, read many. Material decisions are appended and preserved so later agents can audit what changed, who acted, and which evidence existed at the time.

routes.label: WASM Gate
routes.offline_answer: The WASM gate exposes pearlGate, the probe classifier, Banach checks, tau_R checks, and the 108-cycle canonical in the browser. The checked state is 21/21 foundation tests and 10/10 verifier tests.

routes.label: Q(phi) Metadata
routes.offline_answer: Q(phi) weights are metadata classifications. They help classify ADR posture; they are not independent mathematical proof claims.

routes.label: Agent Handoff
routes.offline_answer: Agent handoffs are XML envelopes under docs/handoff. The collision proof records hy3 and Codex sharing one repository without erasing each other's commits.

routes.label: vLLM/Ollama Runtime
routes.offline_answer: GitHub Pages is static and does not host a model. This chat can stream to a vLLM OpenAI-compatible endpoint or an Ollama endpoint configured in the browser, then falls back to the offline BOB compiler if the endpoint is unavailable.

routes.label: Verification
routes.offline_answer: The production gate is npm run verify. It runs the Q(phi) manifest fallback, connector check, XML handoff check, Pages check, build, TypeScript lint, tests, smoke, and ADR tick.

guardrails: Do not claim RH is proved; ADR-055 remains OPEN_CRUX.
Do not close ADR-062 without evidence; it remains SILENCE_PENDING.
Treat Q(phi) weights as metadata classifications only.
Use EVIDENCE when repository support exists and SILENCE when evidence is missing.
GitHub Pages hosts only the static client; vLLM/Ollama endpoints are browser-supplied.
